acceptedAnswer.text: MyWorkLog is a free progressive web app (PWA) for apprentice time tracking. It offers a digital report book, a flextime account, an overtime calculator, an AI assistant and cloud sync. It works 100% offline and is GDPR-compliant.
Yes, MyWorkLog is completely free and open source (MIT licence). No hidden costs, no ads. All data stays local on your device.
Yes. MyWorkLog is an offline-first PWA with a service worker. Once loaded, the app works entirely without an internet connection. Data is stored locally in your browser.
Yes. By default MyWorkLog stores all data locally on your device (local storage). Cloud sync is optional and only happens with your explicit consent. No tracking cookies, no advertising.

mainEntity.name: Can I install MyWorkLog on my phone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. MyWorkLog is an installable PWA. Open myworklog.de in Chrome or Safari, tap 'Add to home screen' and you are done. The app then runs like a native app.

p2pWizStep1.uebertraegt_eintraege_direkt: Sends entries straight from one device to the other. The connection needs no server: one device creates a code, the other enters it.

settingsTabTeam.uebertraegt_deine_eintra: Sends your entries straight between two devices, from your phone to your laptop for example. There is no shared account and no notifications to anyone else: your data stays yours, one more device simply joins in.
settingsTabTeam.sofort_uebertragen_sobal: Transfer as soon as the connection is up

settingsTabTeam.die_uebertragung_laeuft_: The transfer runs directly between your devices, with no central server. The steps: create a code, enter the code, hand back the reply code. If the connection will not come up, a strict firewall or a VPN is usually in the way.
